name: Fugitive Desires
source: You were living a pretty average life until one night, you hear a strange noise coming from upstairs. When you go to check out what it is, you find that a woman has been murdered! You panic and try to call the cops, but suddenly everything goes black as you pass out... When you wake up, you find the bloody murder weapon in your hand! Before you know it, you've been arrested by the police. All of the evidence points to you being the murderer! But that night, a lone detective comes to your aid. He helps you escape the holding cell and tells you that the true murderer is still out there. Will you be able to prove your innocence and find the killer?!
translation: 你的生活原本十分平凡，直到某天夜里，楼上传来了奇怪的声音。你前去查看，竟发现一名女子遭到杀害！你惊慌失措，正想报警，却突然眼前一黑，失去了意识……醒来时，沾满鲜血的凶器竟握在自己手中！还没反应过来，你就被警方逮捕了。所有证据都指向你就是凶手！然而，当晚一名侦探独自赶来相助。他帮你逃出拘留室，并告诉你，真正的凶手仍逍遥法外。你能否证明自己的清白，找出真凶？！
